title: Wear OS: Crash on scrolling menu settings
symptom: On the watch app, double clicking on a watch face to open the menu, going to Settings, and scrolling down causes the app to close with exceptions related to file access and logging.
cause: The crash is caused by missing permission on the watch, specifically the app attempts to write logs to a directory that is not allowed, leading to an IllegalArgumentException and FileNotFoundException.
fix: The issue is not related to a crash but only missing permission on watch. It is suggested that logs should not be enabled by default, and possibly a switch for users to enable when troubleshooting.
evidence_quote: this is not related to any crash ... only missing permission on watch. i don't think it's necessary to store logs on watch because of it's battery and memory
